title_original: Suspected Vietnam-Linked Hackers Target Southeast Asia in South China Sea Espionage Campaign

title_original: Japan’s education ministry discloses breach of government procurement system
description: Japan’s education ministry disclosed earlier this week that hackers breached its government procurement system, potentially exposing records containing business information and email addresses.
